sections.text: The Problem Your ads work. Your phone doesn't. You're paying $40–$300 per lead on Google Ads, LSAs, and HomeAdvisor. But the expensive part isn't the ad spend — it's the leads that ring through at 11pm, hit voicemail, and book your competitor by morning. Missed calls go straight to your competition Most callers won't leave a voicemail — they dial the next name on Google. Every missed ring is a $175–$8,500 job walking out the door. Your phone rings loudest after hours Burst pipe at 11pm. Sparking outlet on Saturday. Roof leak at midnight. Your ads work — but you're off the clock when your customers need you most. Reviews decide who shows up on Google The contractors with the most Google reviews dominate the map pack. Without a review system, you're invisible where homeowners actually search. Here's how RhinoBot closes all three gaps. ↓
